scenes.say: Popcorn versus potato chips. Which snack wins game day?
scenes.headline: POPCORN VS CHIPS

scenes.say: We're comparing three cups of air popped popcorn with one ounce of chips. Round one, fiber.
scenes.headline: ROUND 1: FIBER

scenes.say: Round two, calories. Popcorn gives you a big bowl for about ninety three.
scenes.headline: ROUND 2: CALORIES

scenes.say: But round three is a surprise. Chips have fewer carbs per serving!
scenes.headline: ROUND 3: CARBS

scenes.say: Round four, fat. Chips are fried, with about ten times more.
scenes.headline: ROUND 4: FAT

scenes.say: Three rounds to one. The winner is air popped popcorn, a whole grain snack!
scenes.headline: POPCORN WINS

scenes.say: Skip the movie theater butter. Use a light spray of oil and your favorite spices.
scenes.headline: KEEP IT LIGHT

scenes.say: Measure about three cups into a bowl, and enjoy the game.
scenes.headline: 3 CUPS. ONE BOWL.
